title: Rhythm section and Fred's four-piece group
summary: Rhythm section of Desvigne's band; after three or four years he forms a quartet with Kimball, Barbarin and Alcorn that fills in around touring bands.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I can't think of the bass player. Rain was playing at that time, playing bass. And I was playing the guitar. Kimball was playing the bass. That's right. Young Kimball. That was the band then. And we stayed with that band about three or four years with Sidney's. And left them. Then I went and got Kimball, Louis Barbaran, Alvin Alcorn, and myself with the full tunes.
Sounds like a good night singing. Where did you play? Any special longer engagements?

Well, we just played all engagements around town. We would play after the bands or before the bands would come. Like Louis Armstrong, King Cole. And those bands would come in during that time to play dances, concert, and we would fill in a standby group.
